properties.name: Transcontinental Hotel
properties.whatWasHere: Furthest-north hotel in SA at opening. Foundation stone laid 5 June 1878 by a local Aboriginal woman. Later boarding house and cottage hospital; closed as hotel c. August 1918. Kidman converted to cottage/hospital; bush nursing 1928–1945.
properties.geometryNote: Centroid snapped to OpenStreetMap historic feature (2026 extract); footprint size illustrative.

properties.name: Exchange Hotel
properties.whatWasHere: Hotel operating c.1880–December 1937 (FRG also notes 1879 opening in navigating notes). Corner of Eleventh Street and North Terrace area.
properties.geometryNote: Centroid snapped to OpenStreetMap historic feature (2026 extract); footprint size illustrative.

properties.name: Post Office
properties.whatWasHere: Post office 1878–1960. Surviving building dates from the 1890s per FRG; telegraph connection to Overland Telegraph Line.
properties.geometryNote: Centroid snapped to OpenStreetMap historic feature (2026 extract); footprint size illustrative.

properties.name: Scotch Oven Underground Bakery
properties.whatWasHere: Underground scotch oven bakery built early 20th century (exact year uncertain). Restored 2010; used seasonally by FRG volunteers.
properties.geometryNote: Centroid snapped to OpenStreetMap historic feature (2026 extract); footprint size illustrative.

properties.name: Manfield / Bell General Store
properties.whatWasHere: Bell then Mansfield/Manfield general store. John Mansfield associated to c.1920 with camel trains; Bell family store 1920–1967 (FRG town guide). Exact footprint approximate.

properties.name: Blacksmith Forge & Stables
properties.whatWasHere: Blacksmith forge and stables on First Street (FRG trail). Closure year approximate.
properties.placementNote: Snapped toward Twelfth Street commercial spine (approximate site).

properties.name: Police Station & Cells
properties.whatWasHere: Police station built 1890s; closed 1950s after flood damage; police relocated to Leigh Creek.
properties.geometryNote: Centroid snapped to OpenStreetMap historic feature (2026 extract); footprint size illustrative.

properties.name: Old Police Station
properties.whatWasHere: Earlier police station (opened 1876 replacing tent by creek). Wooden slab building closed 1935 per FRG navigating notes.

properties.name: Anglican Church
properties.whatWasHere: Anglican Church 1890–1967. Bell stand and interpretive photos remain on site.

properties.name: Moffatt House
properties.whatWasHere: Family home of Robert Moffatt; masonry residence with kitchen stove and slate flooring remnants.
properties.geometryNote: Centroid snapped to OpenStreetMap historic feature (2026 extract); footprint size illustrative.

properties.name: Finn Family House
properties.whatWasHere: Home of Nat & Lucy Finn and their seven daughters, 1889–1944. Square water tank with daughters' names inscribed.
properties.geometryNote: Centroid snapped to OpenStreetMap historic feature (2026 extract); footprint size illustrative.

properties.name: Patterson House
properties.whatWasHere: John 'Gordie' Patterson family home from c.1920; Pattersons lived at Farina until 1982. Rebuilt by FRG 2017–2019; original fireplace retained.
properties.geometryNote: Centroid snapped to OpenStreetMap historic feature (2026 extract); footprint size illustrative.

properties.name: Angels Rest
properties.whatWasHere: Residence associated with Celia Morris, who supported the town's young women. Burial marked in the cemetery.

properties.name: Farina Railway Station
properties.whatWasHere: Railway station and facilities from railhead opening 22 May 1882. Precinct included goods shed, yards, water tower, fettlers' cottages. Line closed 1980s; rails removed 1993.
properties.geometryNote: Centroid snapped to OpenStreetMap historic feature (2026 extract); footprint size illustrative.
